scenario: Adopt Lintwise as a required pre-merge check (eight engineers)

motion.text: The team conducts a non-blocking Lintwise trial in its monorepo, agreeing beforehand on acceptance criteria and measuring actionable findings, false-positive rates, language and rule coverage, guidance clarity, CI time, and queue impact, including caching and rule tuning. Any later proposal to require individual rules must document their requirements, trial evidence, and rollback conditions.

objectors.reason: We have not assessed Lintwise’s impact on our 11-minute CI builds or queue length before making it mandatory.
The mandatory rule set and trial evidence remain unspecified, including whether secrets and dependency risks are covered.
We have not established whether Lintwise’s Python and SQL checks are reliable enough to require for our data pipelines.
We have not established readiness for mandatory checks through a trial with measured false-positive rates and a rollback path.
We have not established which rules would be required or provided clear guidance for resolving findings before making Lintwise mandatory.

chairQuestions.topic: Useful findings and noise in prior use
chairQuestions.experience_sought: During your six months using Lintwise, what kinds of real bugs did it catch, and what noisy warnings did you encounter?

chairQuestions.topic: JavaScript findings on a side project
chairQuestions.experience_sought: What useful findings or noisy warnings did Lintwise produce on your JavaScript side project?

reminders.quote: Lintwise also has a baseline mode that ignores existing findings and reports only new ones.
Our merge-policy changes need a trial period and a rollback path; we have reversed two past policy changes after rolling them out repo-wide at once.
